messages:
marta: uploaded a "timeline zoom" prototype — frame: Repo > Timeline Zoom (Figma: https://figma.com/file/zoom987). Idea: pinch/stretch the timeline to reveal finer-grained versions and snapshots without expanding the page height.
jason: neat. accessibility check: zoom changes must be announced to SR: "Timeline zoom level 2 of 5" and preserve focus. Also keyboard shortcuts: +/- to zoom, but include modifier (shift) to avoid conflict. recommend: Alt+Plus / Alt+Minus.
kevin: UX nit: when zoomed in, variant bars become tiny — add an accessible alternative view (list view toggle) and a clear legend toggle. Also percent controls need aria-valuenow updates when keyboarded.
anya: copy: primary rollback action reads "Rollback to this" — consider "Restore snapshot" when user is clicking a historical snapshot, and keep "Revert to previous" for immediate rollback. In confirmation modal show a short bullet list of consequences.
sam: visual: tiny snapshot chips currently use color only. add a patterned ring + a 1-letter badge (H for historical, C for current). Also ensure high contrast backgrounds for snapshot labels in dark mode.
marta: thinking about a 'snapshot restore' flow: click snapshot -> open side panel with diff + preview of traffic split. CTA: "Restore snapshot v2026-03-01" and muted line: "Undo available for 3 minutes". Questions: do we need an optional 'reason' field on restore for audit logs?
jason: audit 'reason' could be optional and small (textarea limited to 140 chars). keep it collapsed by default with a "Add reason (optional)" toggle.
kevin: keyboard/focus: side panel must trap focus only while modal-like actions are active. For lightweight preview, don't trap; allow arrow nav to move timeline. Use aria-expanded on snapshot row and aria-labelledby for panel header.
anya: microcopy: prefer "Restore snapshot" over "Rollback" and use passive phrasing in body: "Traffic will be routed to the snapshot. Active requests may be interrupted." add "may be interrupted" to soften tone.
sam: contrast test: percent badge over heatmap fails AA in dark theme. options: add semi-opaque backing or show percentage as plain text to the right when space is tight.
design-bot: Accessibility checklist: ARIA live for zoom & scrubber, keyboard shortcuts + discoverability, color+pattern indicators, focus management for panels, contrast >=4.5:1, SR text for snapshot badges.
marta: action items: 1) add ARIA live announcement on zoom & scrubber (jason) 2) implement list-view toggle + ensure percent aria updates (kevin) 3) swap "Rollback" -> "Restore snapshot" copy + undo microcopy (anya) 4) pattern ring + H/C badges + dark mode contrast fixes (sam) 5) prototype side panel restore flow with optional reason field and focus behavior (marta). I'll push v3 frames tomorrow AM and tag reviewers.
kevin: one tiny copy tweak: in modal body use "may be interrupted" not "may interrupt". also change primary button text to the full snapshot name to reduce ambiguity.
anya: +1 to including snapshot timestamp in CTA e.g., "Restore snapshot 2026-03-01 14:02". keeps it clear.
marta: great — thanks team, will update and post link. :sparkles:
